7.text: Anthropic filed an IPO prospectus revealing $518 billion in planned cloud and data-center spending, including $110 billion committed to Amazon Web Services through 2036, and could go public before OpenAI. The articles focus on Anthropic's spending and IPO, bearing on Alphabet only indirectly through the broader AI compute build-out.

5.text: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, added Guided Vision to Gemini Live on Android, and partnered with Constellation Energy on a $4.3 billion nuclear upgrade plus an 890 MW capacity deal. It also faces a UK class action over Play Store fees, while Fujifilm and Socure announced Google-related integrations.

11.text: Berkshire’s NEAM unit cut Alphabet and Broadcom positions, while Berkshire still holds 106 million Alphabet shares worth $35.5 billion. Coverage also compares Apple and Alphabet’s AI strategies and discusses Greg Abel’s portfolio reshuffling.

4.text: Amazon plans roughly $220 billion in 2026 capex, is raising AI chip rental prices, signed a $1B+ Synopsys chip deal, and trades at its lowest-ever valuation despite AWS growing 37% to $42.2B. Alphabet appears only in a comparative "better buy" piece against Amazon and Microsoft.

12.text: Meta launched its Muse personal AI agent on September 8, which topped ChatGPT's iOS launch metrics within 10 days, and is expanding Muse to small businesses and enterprise AI. Meta stock rose roughly 26% in a month, though its AI spending and Reality Labs losses remain concerns; one article compares Alphabet favorably on valuation.

6.text: Alphabet articles report Q2 2026 results including 30% operating income growth and 82% Google Cloud revenue growth, plus the Gemini 4 Argon launch and TPU expansion. They also note the stock trades near $338, down about 15% from highs, with analysts projecting upside to $5 trillion by 2028.

8.text: Adobe stock fell 16.4% in a month and 33% in a year, trading at 13x earnings versus the S&P 500's 21.4x, about 58% below its December 2024 high. Snap trades 58% below its two-year high with an 8.1% free-cash-flow yield; Alphabet is not mentioned.
